## Reuse

- Read set loads through the existing disk loaders on the cache dir — no new readers (ledger decision).
- `readySet(state, nodes)` gives ready/waiting with reasons; blocked rows reuse `reasons` verbatim.
- `resolvePhaseRef` already resolves local and `spec#phase` refs → use it to count "unblocks" instead of
  re-parsing refs.
- `isOverdue`, `priorityRank`, `NO_DUE` ordering → `compareSchedule`.
- Factories: `tests/factories.ts` `phaseState`, `specNode`, `phaseEdges` feed `board-factories.ts`.

## Testing-issue estimate

1. **`git archive` refuses unmatched pathspecs** (probed): `fatal: pathspec ':(glob)*/docs/specs/*/*.md'
   did not match any files`, exit 128, in any repo with only one spec root. `ls-tree` rejects `glob` magic.
   → list the tree (`ls-tree -r --name-only -z <sha>`), keep only the patterns that match at least one
   path (`Bun.Glob`, whose `*` stops at `/` like `:(glob)`), archive with those. No pattern matches → empty
   base dir, no archive call. Pure `matchingPatterns(paths)` gets its own test.
2. **Timeout test** needs a real slow child (`sleep`) with a short `timeoutMs`; ~300 ms. `exitedDueToTimeout`
   → readable `stderr` (`timed out after N ms`) so `git.out` reasons say why.
3. **No `addWorktree` / common-dir helper yet**; baseCache only needs `repoWithOrigin` + `git rev-parse
   --git-common-dir`. Concurrent-extract safety tested by pre-creating `base/<sha>/` then calling (the
   rename loser path), not by real parallelism.
4. **Size caps**: `board/lanes.ts` holds in-flight placeholder + ready + blocked + prep/create rows +
   needs-you (overdue, deploy). Needs-you is `attention.ts` per technical.md — create it now with the two
   items this phase fills, so `lanes.ts` stays well under 250.
5. **Async `Command.run`** is item 7 (next chunk); nothing in 1–5 needs it.
6. **Time**: `buildBoard(inputs, now)` takes `now`; overdue compares `isoDay(now)` — `isoDay` uses local
   getters, bun test is UTC; fixed `now` in tests keeps it stable.
7. No domain smells on the path; `portfolio/order.ts` duplication (priority→due) is exactly what item 1
   removes.
